erp_dictionary.live_warning: These entries live-drive rendering of the legacy ERP and the modern SPA's translation dictionary. This backend is new: until now it was only written from internal scripts, never from a web screen. Filter by group or search before editing.
erp_dictionary.pick_filter_hint: Pick a group or type a search to see entries.
erp_dictionary.label: Text

ups_token_status.subtitle: Read-only status of the UPS OAuth token
ups_token_status.scope_note: Read-only: does not renew or revoke the token. Actual renewal remains the UPS module's responsibility, not this screen's.

googlemaps_address_fields.subtitle: Per country, which Google Places field is province vs city
googlemaps_address_fields.scope_note: Values must be a real Google address_component type — an incorrect value doesn't break anything, but silently stops autofilling that column for that country.

freschi_import.subtitle: Bulk-load KO/remote zones by file, replaces the whole set
freschi_import.replace_warning: This import replaces ALL existing zones for supplier "Freschi e Schiavoni" in Italy — it is not incremental. If any line in the file has an error, nothing gets imported.
freschi_import.result_failed: Import rejected: {n} lines with errors, nothing was imported

dhl_import.subtitle: Bulk-load DHL airports and priority services
dhl_import.replace_warning_airports: This import replaces ALL existing airports/facilities (~1.6M rows) — it is not incremental. Upload the .txt file (ESDFacilityID.txt) directly, not the .zip.
dhl_import.replace_warning_priority: This import replaces ALL existing priority service availability — it is not incremental. If any line in the file has an error, nothing gets imported.
dhl_import.airport_file_hint: Large file (~1.6M rows). May take several minutes.
dhl_import.result_failed: Import rejected: {n} lines with errors, nothing was imported
dhl_import.errors_truncated: Only the first errors are shown — more lines have issues.

supplier_tracking_codes.subtitle: Per-supplier tracking code dictionary (fnt_track / fnt_trackerr)
supplier_tracking_codes.pick_fornitore: Pick a supplier to view its codes.

tracking_statuses.subtitle: Multi-language texts for the tracking statuses shown to the customer in public tracking.
tracking_statuses.live_warning: The id and type of these rows feed the shipment state machine and overdue-pickup detection live. Only the texts and note are editable.
tracking_statuses.readonly_hint: Id, type and open-storage are read-only: changing them would affect the shipment lifecycle across the whole application.

cargo_charges.subtitle: Charge/surcharge code catalogue used in WebCargo quotations
cargo_charges.live_warning: The "Applies" field decides live whether this charge is added to a WebCargo quotation total. A change here affects the calculated price of future quotations.
cargo_charges.scelta_hint: Only "Yes" adds the charge to the total; anything else is treated as not included
